test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The market value of Amal’s investment rises successively by 5% in 2021, 6% in 2022, and 10% in 2023. If the initial value was ₹5,50,000, what will be its value (in ₹) at the end of 2023?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier = 1.05 × 1.06 × 1.10 = 1.2243

Final Value = 5,50,000 × 1.2243

Final Value = 5,50,000 × (1 + 0.05 + 0.06 + 0.10 + small decimals) ≈ 5,50,000 × 1.22

Calculation: 5,50,000 × 1.05 × 1.06 × 1.1 = 6,73,365

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,73,365.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5402c06527ca72a3566e93c6dd4c7acb696d6920154b26e8b6e4fd7056e2c90.png] 

**Given:**

**Initial Value (P)** = ₹5,50,000

**Successive growth rates**: r₁ = 5%, r₂ = 6%, r₃ = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = P × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Final Value = 5,50,000 × (105/100) × (106/100) × (110/100)

⇒ Final Value = 5,50,000 × (21/20) × (53/50) × (11/10)

⇒ Final Value = 550000 × (21 × 53 × 11) ÷ (20 × 50 × 10)

⇒ Final Value = 550000 × 12243 ÷ 10000

⇒ Final Value = 55 × 12243

⇒ Final Value = 6,73,365

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,73,365.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes a% and b%, the net effective change is (a + b + ab/100)%.

Depreciation Formula

If the value decreases, the formula becomes Final Value = P × (1 − r/100)ⁿ.

Unit Digit Trick

Multiplying 5 (from 5.5) with odd numbers often ends in 5; checking unit digits can eliminate options in complex calculations.
